Definition: literally he will contend; properly, adjective, contentious; used as noun, an adversary
BiblicalUsage: Yârîyb is the adversary, the one who contends against God's people. The LORD promises to contend with him that contends with His children, and Jeremiah asks God to hear the voice of those who contend with him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God takes up the case of His people, and my adversary is His adversary.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
